title: Finite Contact Theory v0.9: The Multi-Floor Worldweave — A Forcing Audit of the E_8-Hexacode Spine
description: A finite reconstruction program for admissible reality. This v0.9 chapter extends the contact-interface line (v0.8) from one cell to a population. Independently generated non-exact-return cells do not combine by tensor product; each carries a D_4 triality boundary, and cells become one world by settling those boundary debts into a self-dual bridge code (a receiver-complete world is a self-dual code). Verified by exact finite checks: two cells close uniquely into the E_8 root system (240 = 48 + three triality-matched 64-root bridges; glue-lattice determinant ladder 16 to 4 to 1); local fusion is octonionic, with nonassociativity a pure three-contact order receipt (7 of 35 imaginary triples associate); normed monolithic fusion stops at the octonions (the sedenions have zero divisors); the triality-covariant Hermitian self-dual standard-form code census is |GU(N/2,2)| = 3, 18, 648 through six cells; and six cells are the first population able to form a complete world invisible to every pairwise and triple probe, canonically the hexacode [6,3,4] with weight enumerator 1 + 45 y^4 + 18 y^6 (162 of the 648 six-cell codes have minimum distance 2, 486 have distance 4). The native global object is an evolving bridge code. A forcing audit then proves those closure laws are not floor-selected over matched lawful alternatives (a doubly-even self-dual [24,12,4] counterworld to Golay, verified by the MacWilliams identity; the scale-free bridge determinant; both V4 and C3 as triality alphabets; a dual pole H strictly inside its dual rather than self-duality; and E_8+E_8+E_8's 720 roots), and a dynamic selection-equivalence theorem (of 256 maps on four phases exactly 64 strictly settle, each Lyapunov; reversible dynamics has stationary law proportional to e^{-V}) shows dynamics only relocates a conserved selector. So the floor forces the atlas of lawful closures and the terminal self-dual class but never the specific member; world-phase selection is a conserved received input, while a given actual phase has its Born response (the 24-cell counting kernel) and its binding arity (the dual distance) forced. Named objects are recovered in a derivational role; the result is structural under named closure axioms, and does not show that nature realizes E_8, the hexacode, or any code, nor derive any metric, spectrum, or dimensionful constant. Two dependency-free scripts verify the chapter from a clean clone in exact arithmetic.
